comparison.objective: Load and crack a walnut with a figure nutcracker; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever opening, object placement, and forceful fracture versus precision countertorque adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Shell seam physically broken and grippers clear versus accurate locked opening and nondestructive repeated motion.
comparison.reason: Fracture tool operation is not equivalent to gripper-stop calibration.
